findings.claim: The plan rewrites ADR 0033's Decision text in place, but ADR 0033 is status stable and .claude/rules/okf-bundle.md (Decisions, lines 98-101) says a stable record is never rewritten: a correction is an appended "## Correction, YYYY-MM-DD" section, and only a reversal needs a new record. The path fix is a correction, not a reversal, so no new record is needed, but O2 should say: append a Correction section naming configure_dns.yml, and repoint the sources front matter so kmctl review due tracks the new file. The repo already uses this form (ADR 0005, 0006, 0019).
ADR 0033 is stable and the plan rewrote its body in place; the revision appends a Correction section instead.
